result.title: Resilience Analysis Through Automated Stage Identification and Quantitative Assessment
result.summary: This paper introduced an ML-based approach, designed to be domain- and threat-agnostic, for automated recognition of PARA (Plan/Prepare, Absorb, Recover, Adapt) resilience stages in system-performance time series, enabling subsequent quantitative resilience analysis across different systems. We investigate four ML models for resilience stage recognition: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). We then use the ML models' predictions to quantify system resilience by computing corresponding resilience metrics from system-performance data observed before, during, and after disruptive events. We evaluate the proposed approach using datasets from two distinct operational domain network systems and an airport transportation system, demonstrating its domain-agnostic applicability to resilience assessment. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of resilience stage classification, with the best F1-scores ranging from 74.3% to 99.4% across all resilience stages. The overall resilience metrics R_t and RL are estimated, with the best models' MAPE ranging from 0.35-0.82% on IEEE 802.11 and LTE to 1.65-9.56% for the airport. These results provide a basis for threat-agnostic resilience analysis of complex engineering systems, enabling further assessment of how effectively a system withstands, absorbs, and recovers from disruptive events and stress conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种领域与威胁无关的机器学习方法，用 RF、SVM、LightGBM、XGBoost 从系统性能时间序列中自动识别 PARA（Plan/Prepare、Absorb、Recover、Adapt）韧性阶段，并据预测计算扰动前后的韧性指标，在两个网络系统与机场交通数据上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把时间序列自动切分为语义阶段并做分类与量化评估的思路，可能可供核查用于从 latent 状态轨迹或计算量曲线中识别 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等推理阶段；但研究对象是工程系统韧性，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，借鉴价值需较多核查。
